Mirza Jaffer Abid (Jaffer) is a historian who works on the history of Islam in modern South Asia and focuses on the intersections of intellectual and political history. He is broadly interested in the colonial and postcolonial history of Muslims in South Asia, Islamic reform and anticolonial modernisms in the global Muslim world.
